उड्डीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flown up, flying up.
 n. (-नं)
 1. Flying as a bird.
2. Flying up, soaring.
 E. उत् up, and डी to fly, क्त aff.

उड्डीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flying, soaring, who flies or soars.
 E. उत् up,
डी to fly, शानच् aff.

उड्डीश m. (-शः)
 1. A work so called, containing charms and incanta-
tions.
 2. A name of ŚIVA.
 E. उत् up, and डी to fly, Unādi affix श.
